method: Independent manual reading of every literal source/expected pair in seven batches; expected data inspected structurally, without renderer or reference-model outputs. Primary flowchart headers independently classified across all 548 original sources. Source bodies independently reread from pinned git pages. Hashes bind the exact audited contracts, not approval of renderer outputs. Initial root snapshot differed from requested2cc55cf only by86 direction/advisory projections; every such delta was independently compared and recorded before rebinding all hashes to exact target contracts.

findings.problem: Extra-dash link minimum-rank requests are silently discarded while expectedFactsComplete=true.
findings.sourceAuthority: Pinned flowchart.md lines894-939 explain minimum rank spans and marker-length table. :903/:919 use ----> (minimum3); :1040 uses ---> (minimum2).
findings.requiredChange: Preserve each authored length request in a layout-hint/constraint fact, or explicitly withhold completeness. Do not invent strict pixel lengths or treat requests as exact coordinates.

resolution.status: Authored requests preserved explicitly as advisory facts, without guessed strict geometry

findings.problem: Markdown source-label facts have no node/edge/group ownership. :1096 has identical visible dog text on b and d, but only b requests bold dog. A text-only formatting projection can borrow the other node.
findings.requiredChange: Preserve authored owners or exact source coordinates on Markdown facts; require matching owned painted occurrences. Unsupported formatting must stay unknown.

resolution.status: Owned source facts repaired; formatting observation must still qualify independently

resolution.status: Authored requests preserved explicitly as advisory facts, without guessed strict geometry

scope: Literal transcription/structural expectation audit only. Does not certify every SVG observer, image, style, font, layout or PNG oracle. Existing source-review completeness is transcription metadata, not a drawing correctness score.
